name: Neurocite-SB
description: A BioForge Labs proprietary ceramic developed specifically to interface with Synthetic Neural Tissue, incorporating a calcium silicate matrix doped with conductive bioactive glass channels that allow SNT to extend axonal processes directly into and through the ceramic body, creating a living composite where the neural tissue and ceramic substrate become functionally integrated. The result is an armor or housing material that responds to neural signal inputs — stiffening under threat stimulus, rerouting structural load around damage sites, and transmitting sensory data to the wearer's nervous system. Neurocite-SB represents the leading edge of bio-ceramic integration and remains extraordinarily expensive.
story_hooks: A Neurocite-SB armor panel has been separated from its wearer and is still alive — the SNT within it is attempting to find a neural connection, and it is broadcasting distress signals on biological frequencies that medical scanners are picking up across the district.

A Tier 5 client's Neurocite-SB personal armor has begun exhibiting autonomous behavior, subtly redirecting the wearer away from certain locations — someone has introduced a behavioral modification into the SNT substrate, and the client doesn't know they're being steered.

BioForge Labs has quietly discontinued a batch of Neurocite-SB after discovering the SNT integration allows the ceramic to form memories of the wearer's movement patterns — patterns that are apparently being harvested remotely by an unknown party.
